cards.title: Priya Raman
cards.text: General manager. Twenty years of guiding sea-kayak trips before she ran the store.

cards.title: Ines Okafor
cards.text: Board chair. A member since 1994 and a former ranger.

cards.title: Theo Lindqvist
cards.text: Repair lead. Fixes zippers, stoves, and once, a canoe.

cards.title: Dana Brooks
cards.text: Rental manager. Knows where every kayak is, right now.

cards.title: Sam Whitlock
cards.text: Communications. Writes the newsletter and the trail reports.

cards.title: Marta Ellison
cards.text: Workshop coordinator. Teaches the knots class.
